about_the_game:
Included In the demo:

  • The first two floors of the complex 

  • 5 explorable apartment's 

  • Multiple characters to interact with

  • The unyielding Grandfather

Where are you?

You arrive at your home complex 629 but you lack all your memories but why? The other residents you meet along your journey deeper into the complex speak of the devil constructing the halls you wander. Be aware however for a violent spectre stalks the halls and he is The Grandfather


Make your way through the structure

Dig your way through the halls by moving the snow manually or with the aid of consumables. To Find what lies at the end of the Complex you must collect money to purchase materials so you may complete the construction of your magnum opus. The key to regaining the memories that have been stolen away from you. 


Hoarding wealth and knowledge is okay in the end times 

  •  Collect aspects of the devil to learn more about the complex and the world which lies outside

  • In capitalism only the privileged prevail but since you can find money all over the complex you might have a chance to become rich! That would be if you didn't have to give it to the top 1% to progress

Setting

The world cools year by year and snow encroaches upon civilisations from mountain tops. Frost is the great equalizer now and few thrive. Some countries were better prepared for the cold which came ravenous. Most of all Iceland and that is where you are. That is where the Complex is. Surviving the frost outside is hopeless but once you sign the contract and take residents within the complex hopes of leaving it are none. The Complex giveth so its residents may taketh but the Devil is not so kind. 


Complex 629 is full of things to experience and do

  • Explore a myriad of non-euclidean apartments and places embedded within one building

  • Speak with multiple unique NPCs and learn their stories and experiences

  • Collect oodles of money and then spend it at an overpriced supermarket or gamble it away

  • Collect lore from heart shaped fragments of the Devil

  • Avoid the vile monsters which lie within 

  • Have a girlfriend

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.8Ghz or equivalent
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

short_description: Narrative psychological horror in vivid colour. Explore a surreal Icelandic apartment block built by the Devil. Shovel through snow with your bare hands and Converse with other residents while navigating between non-euclidean apartments and gathering money to escape the violence of Grandfather
